{{Top|leg}}
'''Blast goggles''' were [[Eye/Legends|eye]] protection [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] used when handling [[Plasma cutter/Legends|plasma cutters]] to prevent being blinded. Blast goggles were usually supplied with the cutter, and additional goggles cost fifteen [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
